name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Kishori Mela
benefit:
**The following activities may be undertaken during the event:**

  - Administration of weekly IFA tablet and egg.
  - Screening of nutritionally at-risk adolescent girls (BMI checkup).
  - Screening for anaemia status (haemoglobin testing).
  - Counselling and referrals. The One Stop Centre Counsellors &amp; State Social Welfare Board Counsellors maybe roped in for the purpose alongwith Healt
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be an adolescent girl aged between 15 and 19 years.
